full_details: In the morning the tables took two lines of your own, cords, and a ladder of rope, and nothing under them. At two you were Egeon again, and the shipwreck came out of the right side of your mouth, with the clove in the other cheek. You took the parcel to supper at the Hazel, and that was a mistake. Kemp tried it with his fingers, with his teeth, with a fork, and then with a speech, and the table joined him. You would not say which of the children tied it. A month ago you promised not to carry every household joke out of Henley Street, and you could feel the story getting ready in your mouth. Alice produced a knife without being asked and ended it in one stroke. Inside were two pairs of knitted hose, a cake of your mother's, and a slip in Susanna's hand with nothing on it but whom. You did not open the coffer.
one_sentence: You played Egeon again from the right side of your mouth, and Alice's knife ended the knot.
title: Alice's knife, and the word whom
